name: Société Arabe Internationale de Banque S.A.E

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: earnings are reported in EGP but the security is listed and priced in USD; a multiple across two currencies is not a ratio. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so all are withheld. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 10.87 percent a year from FY2021 (1.993e+07) to FY2025 (3.011e+07), over 4 years
valuation.peFormula: market capitalisation / net profit, the same ratio as price / earnings per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.peEpsSource: the filed earnings-per-share row for FY2025
valuation.pbFormula: market capitalisation / total equity, the same ratio as price / book value per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2024
valuation.psFormula: market capitalisation / revenue, the same ratio as price / revenue per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the market capitalisation behind every multiple of this security carries no price date, so the price each multiple divides is not a dated figure and the multiple cannot be audited.
